title: matucana aurantiaca subsp. hastifera
intro: Matucana aurantiaca subsp. hastifera, commonly known as Easter Cactus or Easter Cactus Hedgehog, is a species of cactus in the genus Matucana. This plant is prized for its vibrant flowers and unique, hedgehog-like stems. The health benefits of Matucana aurantiaca subsp. hastifera include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
